objective: Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.
start: Dropped by Ghost Howl in Mulgore

description: The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the Burning Legion.
Perhaps someone in Bloodhoof Village should know of Ghost Howl's demise....
completion: I can barely believe my old eyes! You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl? I look upon you with new respect, young <class>. You are a <class> of extreme skills!
Let me offer you something. My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.
May it strike true, and bring you renown.
And let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.
